jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: Payrate: $92.00 - $98.00/hr.   Summary: We are seeking a hands-on Data Pipeline Engineer to build and operate Python-based workflows that transform large document and text datasets into high-quality data for AI model training. This role combines OCR processing, data cleaning and validation, scalable pipeline development, and Azure storage management.   Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and optimize Python pipelines for data ingestion, OCR processing, text extraction, cleaning, normalization, and deduplication. Run and monitor large-scale batch processing jobs, investigate failures, and implement reliable retry and recovery mechanisms. Build automated quality checks to identify missing or corrupted files, incomplete OCR outputs, duplicate content, formatting issues, and metadata inconsistencies. Prepare training-ready datasets through filtering, text segmentation, tokenization, and conversion into agreed data formats. Manage bulk uploads, downloads, and synchronization between local processing environments and Azure storage; verify transfer completeness and data integrity. Organize raw data, intermediate outputs, and released datasets with consistent naming, metadata, versioning, and source traceability. Optimize processing throughput, memory usage, storage consumption, and cloud costs using appropriate batch, parallel, or distributed processing approaches. Track dataset statistics, processing coverage, quality metrics, and exceptions; produce clear operational reports. Collaborate with applied scientists and model-training teams to translate data requirements into reproducible processing workflows. Maintain tested, documented, version-controlled code and follow established data access, security, and governance requirements.   Qualifications Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or a data science role with substantial production programming responsibilities. Strong proficiency in Python, including writing reusable modules, debugging, testing, logging, and handling processing errors. Hands-on experience processing large structured and unstructured datasets using memory-efficient, parallel, or distributed techniques. Practical experience with Azure Blob Storage or Azure Data Lake Storage, including bulk data transfers, storage organization, and access troubleshooting. Familiarity with Python data-processing libraries and formats such as pandas, NumPy, JSON/JSONL, CSV, and Parquet. Working knowledge of SQL, Git, Linux environments, and command-line tools. Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to data quality, and ability to communicate technical issues clearly.   Skills Experience with OCR pipelines, scanned documents, multilingual text, or document-layout processing. Experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Data Factory, or workflow orchestration tools. Familiarity with Hugging Face Datasets, tokenization, near-duplicate detection, and training/evaluation data separation. Experience with dataset lineage, reproducibility, containerized environments, and CI/CD.   Pay Transparency: The typical base pay for this role across the U.S. is: $92.00 - $98.00 /hour . Non-exempt positions are eligible for overtime at a rate of 1.5 times the base hourly rate for all hours worked in excess of 40 in a work week, or as required by state or local law. Final offer amounts, within the base pay set forth above, are determined by factors including your relevant skills, education and experience. Full-time employees are eligible to select from different benefits packages. Packages may include medical, dental, and vision benefits, health savings accounts with qualified medical plan enrollment, 10 paid days off, 3 days paid bereavement leave, 401(k) plan participation with employer match, life and disability insurance, commuter benefits, dependent care flexible spending account, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, accommodations and reimbursement for work travel, and discretionary performance or recognition bonus. Sick leave and mobile phone reimbursement provided based on state or local law.    Consent to Communication and Use of AI Technology: By submitting your application for this position and providing your email address(es) and/or phone number(s), you consent to receive text (SMS), email, and/or voice communication whether automated (including auto telephone dialing systems or automatic text messaging systems), pre-recorded, AI-assisted, or individually initiated from Aditi Consulting, our agents, representatives, or affiliates at the phone number and/or email address you have provided. These communications may include information about potential opportunities and information. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency may vary. You represent and warrant that the email address(es) and/or telephone number(s) you provided to us belong to you and that you are permitted to receive calls, text (SMS) messages, and/or emails at these contacts. Calls may be recorded.   Consent is not a condition of purchasing any property, goods, or services. jobs.description: Title: Data Analyst Location: Houston, TX (Hybrid) Salary Range: $90,000-130,000 Type: Full-Time No C2C or 3rd Party Vendors at this time. Reporting To: Director of Business Intelligence / Analytics Manager Position Overview A growing organization is seeking a Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across multiple business units. This individual will work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, analyze operational and financial data, identify trends, develop dashboards, and provide actionable insights that improve business performance. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, experience working with large datasets, and the ability to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Key Responsibilities Analyze business, operational, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, and data visualizations. Gather reporting requirements from stakeholders and translate business needs into meaningful analytics solutions. Perform data validation, cleansing, and quality assurance activities to ensure reporting accuracy. Create recurring and ad hoc reports for various business departments. Collaborate with IT, business teams, and leadership to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities. Document reporting processes, business rules, calculations, and data definitions. Assist with data warehouse, ERP, CRM, and business application reporting initiatives. Project & Data Environment Enterprise business systems including ERP, CRM, HRIS, and operational applications. Reporting and analytics environment supporting multiple business units and executive leadership. Cross-functional collaboration with Finance, Operations, Sales, Human Resources, and Information Technology teams. Focus on reporting automation, dashboard development, data governance, and business intelligence. SQL querying and data analysis. Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools. Experience building dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or NetSuite. Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes. Experience with Python, R, or advanced analytics tools. Exposure to financial, operational, or supply chain analytics. Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, energy, construction, or industrial environments. jobs.title: Analyst Data
jobs.description: The Data Analyst will execute the production, analysis, and dissemination of customer and operational metrics to key business stakeholders. You get a thrill out of turning data into actionable information to make a big impact across the organization. You enjoy breaking down the hairiest of problems and sharing your insights with key stakeholders across the organization, and recommending sound business decisions based on insights from the underlying data– your analysis is that good. Although data is important, you always keep the customer front of mind and enjoy optimizing the customer experience, which translates to creating long-term business value. Lastly, you’re ready to join a fast and flat organization where much is expected of you because you have what it takes to influence real change. You’ll enjoy the journey just as much as the outcome, and your positive demeanor will influence others along the way to do the same. Position Responsibilities May Include Deeply understand our organization's data structure and look for ways to improve it to enhance our ability to perform robust data analysis. Deeply understand all sources of data across the enterprise, link to data strategy, and continually evolve the ability to measure and track key data points to enable data-driven decisions Evaluate the effectiveness and financial impact of marketing programs and promotional activities. Collect and provide quantitative and qualitative information to measure the effectiveness of marketing activities and answer strategic business questions Track performance and create KPIs of targeted programs offered to customers to help drive better results Gather and analyze the external market and economic data to better understand correlations to industry and business activity and provide regular insights Utilize BI solutions to improve the timeliness of data and better visibility to decision-makers to help them monitor, measure, or predict how the company is performing Assist with maintenance and management of the Marketing SQL database. Perform marketing research & analysis to inform customer targeting & segmentation, and tracking of Customer Lifetime Value across the enterprise Enable Voice of Customer (VOC) data collection, tracking, and analysis to improve Customer Experience at all levels – end consumer (homeowner), contractor (dealer), and distributor Understand current and target Customer Experience and Customer Journey; create a dashboard to continually measure key metrics to understand gaps and areas that need further attention and investment Create new data sets when there is little or no data available, to inform marketing analysis Work hand-in-hand with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, Logistics, and IT to identify new data sets and how those can be used to bring value to the market and company; engaged third-party vendors and customers as needed. Engage with third-party data providers to strengthen data models as needed Assist with internal assessments of workflow processes to identify inefficiencies, especially those where Marketing is involved, and propose more efficient processes and procedures Provide data and ad hoc analysis to support marketing managers as needed Perform additional projects/duties to support ongoing business needs. Nature & Scope Possesses a broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education. Has no discretion to deviate from established procedures by performing structured work assignments. Work is closely supervised. Problems faced are not typically difficult or complex. Explains facts, policies, and practices related to the job area. Knowledge & Skills Strong data storytelling ability – the ability to produce actionable information/insights, not just data crunching Ability to put results into context, considering the overall business goals and performance. Eager to make a big impact at a large company – you show up for work and get things done Comfortable with experimentation and testing of Minimum Viable Products to determine if proposed business models/solutions scale up Proficient in MS Office, especially Excel, and Access; ability to translate data insights into PowerPoint presentations Proficient with BI tools such as Tableau, DOMO, or Microsoft BI Experience with Qualtrics or other survey tools Understanding of relational databases with experience in SQL or R preferred Natural ability and desire to work on a team; goes the extra mile when needed Ability to work independently. Excellent communication skills, both verbally and written, capable of communicating with people of many different levels of an organization Great analytical skills with attention to detail Ability to grasp complex concepts and systems quickly. Ability to manage multiple projects and shift direction quickly. Intellectual curiosity and strong passion for using data to solve problems. Ability to apply good judgment, strong work ethic, and integrity on the job. Competencies Experience: 0-3 years of work experience in a Marketing / BI Analyst role Proven experience as a BI Analyst working with eCommerce, retail, marketing, and/or web development applications. Experience solving complex business problems involving a heavy amount of analytics. Digital Marketing-based experience preferred. HVAC industry experience preferred but not required Education/Certification Bachelor’s degree in Marketing / Business / Engineering / Statistics / Mathematics / Economics; or another related degree with a strong quantitative emphasis (Optional) Master’s degree in Business Administration / Marketing People Management: No Physical Requirements / Work Environment Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations Reports To Sr. Mgr., Strategic Analytics & Insights (i.e., Head of Strategic Analytics and Insights Dept.) jobs.title: Data Scientist 1
jobs.description: As our Data Scientist, you will act as an internal business consultant to help optimize every facet of this organization. You will solve problems and answer questions – using data – for other departments to help us reduce costs, reduce errors, and be a better organization for our 17 million members. Note: This is a hybrid role; the candidate must reside within a 100-mile radius of our Coppell TX office and be available to work on-site 3 days a week on a regular basis, as well as 2–3 times per month for team meetings and collaboration days. What You’ll Do Every day, you will help solve business problems presented to us by stakeholders using data. You will get a scenario or problem, such as, “We need to reduce cycle times,” and then pull, analyze, and interpret data relevant to that scenario. You will pull data from SQL databases. You will analyze and interpret data using Python, R, or other tools. You will determine patterns or trends and their statistical significance to the problem. To visualize the data, you will use Tableau. Once you have done your analysis, paired with a data engineer, you will present your findings to the stakeholder and confirm, refute or simply acknowledge a hypothesis. Your work may be implemented or may develop into something else. What You’ll Need To thrive in this role, you must have a solid foundation of statistics and data analysis. You must be able to describe a project where you pulled data, analyzed it, identified trends or patterns, determined significance, and delivered insights or recommendations to the business. What was your approach? What tools did you use and why? Did you get to the root cause of the issue? Did you confirm or refute a hypothesis? You must be able to speak to your involvement and decisions at each stage. For pulling data, we use SQL so you must be proficient with this tool. To curate and analyze data, we use a variety of languages and programs: Python, R, and even Excel. You can choose whatever tool helps you best, but you must be proficient in either Python or R. Excellent communication skills and an attitude of flexibility are a must. Very often, we get into the data and some aspect takes longer than we thought, or we have to pivot and change how we approach a problem. A dashboard works better than a model, perhaps. Then you have to explain to the stakeholder or the team why you made that change or why the deliverable is taking longer than expected. It’s all about being creative in your approach and communicating that frequently and clearly to people who may be less tech or data-savvy than you. You have worked previously with an Agile team or understand these concepts. You expect to participate in daily standup meetings, you’ll complete your projects or stories during our bimonthly sprints, and you’re ready to meet frequent deployment deadlines. - SH1 Remarkable benefits: Health coverage for medical, dental, vision 401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension Tuition assistance Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs Paid parental leave Wellness programs Employee discounts (membership, insurance, travel, entertainment, services and more!) Auto Club Enterprises is the largest club within the national AAA federation. We have nearly 17,000 employees in 24 states helping more than 18 million members. The strength of our organization is our employees. Bringing together and supporting different cultures, backgrounds, personalities, and strengths creates a team capable of delivering legendary, lifetime service to our members. When we embrace our diversity – we win. All of Us! With our national brand recognition, long-standing reputation since 1900, and constantly growing membership, we are seeking career-minded, service-driven professionals to join our team. "Through dedicated employees we proudly deliver legendary service and beneficial products that provide members peace of mind and value.” AAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer Our organization participates in E-Verify
